## Mengunduh file

```{r}
#mengambil file dari ena
ena_url <- paste0(
  "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/filereport?",
  "accession=", sra_id,
  "&result=read_run",
  "&fields=run_accession,fastq_ftp",
  "&format=tsv"
)

ena_info <- read.delim(
  ena_url,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

print(ena_info)

# Memastikan tautan FASTQ tersedia
if (nrow(ena_info) == 0 ||
    is.na(ena_info$fastq_ftp[1]) ||
    ena_info$fastq_ftp[1] == "") {
  stop("Tautan FASTQ tidak ditemukan di ENA.")
}

```

```{r}
fastq_files <- strsplit(
  ena_info$fastq_ftp[1],
  ";",
  fixed = TRUE
)[[1]]

fastq_urls <- sub(
  "^ftp://",
  "https://",
  fastq_files
)

# Jika tautan tidak memiliki protokol, tambahkan HTTPS
fastq_urls <- ifelse(
  grepl("^https?://", fastq_urls),
  fastq_urls,
  paste0("https://", fastq_urls)
)

file_paths <- file.path(
  "raw_data",
  basename(fastq_files)
)

#mengunduh fastq
options(timeout = 4800)

for (i in seq_along(fastq_urls)) {

  cat("\nMengunduh file:", basename(file_paths[i]), "\n")

  download.file(
    url = fastq_urls[i],
    destfile = file_paths[i],
    mode = "wb",
    method = "libcurl"
  )
}

cat("\nProses unduhan selesai!\n")


# ukuran file
print(
  data.frame(
    Nama_File = basename(file_paths),
    Ukuran_MB = round(
      file.info(file_paths)$size / (1024^2),
      2
    )
  )
)

```

```{r}


#resume download fastq
curl_exe <- Sys.which("curl.exe")

if (curl_exe == "") {
  curl_exe <- Sys.which("curl")
}

if (curl_exe == "") {
  stop("curl.exe tidak ditemukan di Windows.")
}

# Menampilkan versi curl
system2(curl_exe, "--version")

# Mengatur jumlah percobaan
maks_percobaan <- 10

# Mengunduh setiap file
for (i in seq_along(fastq_urls)) {

  cat("\n====================================\n")
  cat("File:", basename(file_paths[i]), "\n")
  cat("====================================\n")

  berhasil <- FALSE

  for (percobaan in 1:maks_percobaan) {

    cat(
      "\nPercobaan ke-",
      percobaan,
      " dari ",
      maks_percobaan,
      "\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    status <- system2(
      curl_exe,
      args = c(
        "--location",
        "--fail",
        "--connect-timeout", "60",
        "--continue-at", "-",
        "--output", file_paths[i],
        fastq_urls[i]
      )
    )

    if (status == 0) {
      berhasil <- TRUE
      cat("\nUnduhan selesai:", basename(file_paths[i]), "\n")
      break
    }

    if (percobaan < maks_percobaan) {
      cat("Koneksi gagal. Mencoba melanjutkan dalam 5 detik...\n")
      Sys.sleep(5)
    }
  }

  if (!berhasil) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Unduhan belum selesai:",
        basename(file_paths[i]),
        "- jalankan kembali kode ini nanti."
      )
    )
  }
}

cat("\nUkuran file hasil unduhan:\n")

print(
  data.frame(
    Nama_File = basename(file_paths),
    Ukuran_Byte = file.info(file_paths)$size,
    Ukuran_MB = round(
      file.info(file_paths)$size / (1024^2),
      2
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
# File FASTQ input
fastq_path <- "raw_data/SRR8500451_1.fastq.gz"

# Memeriksa keberadaan file
if (!file.exists(fastq_path)) {
  stop("File FASTQ tidak ditemukan di folder raw_data!")
}

# Ukuran pembacaan setiap chunk
chunk_size <- 50000

# Ambang batas filtering yang akan diuji
thresholds <- c(15, 20, 25)

# Rentang skor Phred yang digunakan untuk pencatatan distribusi
phred_levels <- 0:93


# C. FUNGSI PERHITUNGAN PHRED
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Menghitung median berdasarkan frekuensi skor Phred
get_phred_median <- function(counts) {

  total <- sum(counts)

  if (total == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  lower_position <- floor((total + 1) / 2)
  upper_position <- ceiling((total + 1) / 2)

  lower_value <- which(cumsum(counts) >= lower_position)[1] - 1
  upper_value <- which(cumsum(counts) >= upper_position)[1] - 1

  return(mean(c(lower_value, upper_value)))
}


# D. UJI COBA MULTI-THRESHOLD FILTERING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Variabel penyimpanan hasil filtering
total_reads <- 0L

reads_pass <- setNames(
  numeric(length(thresholds)),
  paste0("Q", thresholds)
)

# Matriks untuk menyimpan distribusi skor Phred
phred_counts_filter <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(phred_levels),
  ncol = length(thresholds),
  dimnames = list(
    phred_levels,
    paste0("Q", thresholds)
  )
)

# Membaca FASTQ secara bertahap
stream <- FastqStreamer(fastq_path, n = chunk_size)

open(stream)

tryCatch({

  repeat {

    # Membaca satu chunk
    fq_chunk <- yield(stream)

    if (length(fq_chunk) == 0L) {
      break
    }

    total_reads <- total_reads + length(fq_chunk)

    # Mengubah skor kualitas menjadi matriks numerik
    qual_test <- as(quality(fq_chunk), "matrix")

    # Menghitung rata-rata Phred setiap read
    mean_q <- rowMeans(qual_test, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Menguji ketiga ambang batas
    for (j in seq_along(thresholds)) {

      threshold <- thresholds[j]

      # Filter berdasarkan rata-rata kualitas
      pass_filter <- !is.na(mean_q) & mean_q >= threshold

      reads_pass[j] <- reads_pass[j] + sum(pass_filter)

      # Menghitung distribusi Phred dari read yang lolos
      if (any(pass_filter)) {

        q_values <- as.integer(
          qual_test[pass_filter, , drop = FALSE]
        )

        if (anyNA(q_values) ||
            any(q_values < 0 | q_values > 93)) {
          stop("Ditemukan skor Phred di luar rentang 0-93.")
        }

        phred_counts_filter[, j] <-
          phred_counts_filter[, j] +
          tabulate(q_values + 1L, nbins = 94L)

      }

    }

    cat("Total read diproses:", total_reads, "\n")

  }

}, finally = {
  close(stream)
})


# E. MEMBUAT SUMMARY HASIL FILTERING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

hasil_filtering <- data.frame(

  threshold = thresholds,

  total_read = total_reads,

  read_lolos_filter = as.numeric(reads_pass),

  survival_rate = round(
    as.numeric(reads_pass) / total_reads * 100,
    2
  ),

  mean_phred = sapply(seq_along(thresholds), function(j) {

    counts <- phred_counts_filter[, j]

    if (sum(counts) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    sum(phred_levels * counts) / sum(counts)

  }),

  median_phred = sapply(seq_along(thresholds), function(j) {

    get_phred_median(phred_counts_filter[, j])

  })

)

# Menampilkan hasil filtering
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("       SUMMARY MULTI-THRESHOLD          \n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(hasil_filtering)

# Menyimpan summary
write.csv(
  hasil_filtering,
  "results/filtering_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# F. MENYIMPAN DISTRIBUSI PHRED HASIL FILTERING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

distribusi_phred_filtering <- data.frame(
  phred_score = phred_levels
)

for (j in seq_along(thresholds)) {

  jumlah_basa <- sum(phred_counts_filter[, j])

  if (jumlah_basa > 0) {

    distribusi_phred_filtering[[paste0("Q", thresholds[j])]] <-
      phred_counts_filter[, j] / jumlah_basa * 100

  } else {

    distribusi_phred_filtering[[paste0("Q", thresholds[j])]] <- 0

  }

}

write.csv(
  distribusi_phred_filtering,
  "results/phred_distribution_filtering.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# G. MEMILIH AMBANG FILTERING TERBAIK
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("       PEMILIHAN THRESHOLD TERBAIK      \n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat("Silakan periksa tabel hasil filtering.\n")
cat("Pilih salah satu threshold: 15, 20, atau 25.\n")

best_threshold <- 20

if (length(best_threshold) != 1 ||
    is.na(best_threshold) ||
    !best_threshold %in% thresholds) {

  stop("Pilihan tidak valid. Jalankan kembali dan masukkan 15, 20, atau 25.")

}

cat("\nThreshold terpilih: Q", best_threshold, "\n", sep = "")


# H. FUNGSI SLIDING WINDOW TRIMMING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

trim_one <- function(seq, qual, W = 4, Qmin = 20) {

  q <- as.integer(qual)

  if (length(q) < W) {
    return(list(seq = "", qual = integer(0), end = 0L))
  }

  bad_start <- NA_integer_

  # Memeriksa kualitas pada setiap sliding window
  for (i in seq_len(length(q) - W + 1L)) {

    if (mean(q[i:(i + W - 1L)]) < Qmin) {

      bad_start <- i
      break

    }

  }

  # Menentukan posisi akhir trimming
  end_pos <- if (is.na(bad_start)) {
    length(q)
  } else {
    bad_start - 1L
  }

  if (end_pos < 1L) {

    return(list(seq = "", qual = integer(0), end = 0L))

  }

  return(list(
    seq = substr(seq, 1, end_pos),
    qual = q[seq_len(end_pos)],
    end = as.integer(end_pos)
  ))

}


# I. PRE-PROCESSING PADA HASIL FILTER TERPILIH
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Parameter trimming sesuai instruksi tugas
W <- 4
Qmin <- 20
min_len <- 20

# Lokasi file FASTQ hasil trimming
clean_fastq_path <- "results/clean_sample.fastq.gz"

# Menghapus hasil sebelumnya
if (file.exists(clean_fastq_path)) {
  file.remove(clean_fastq_path)
}

# Variabel penyimpanan hasil trimming
total_reads_trim <- 0L
total_pass_filter <- 0L
total_pass_trim <- 0L

# Distribusi Phred setelah trimming
phred_counts_final <- numeric(length(phred_levels))

# Membaca ulang FASTQ mentah
stream_trim <- FastqStreamer(
  fastq_path,
  n = chunk_size
)

open(stream_trim)

tryCatch({

  repeat { 

    fq_chunk <- yield(stream_trim)

    if (length(fq_chunk) == 0L) {
      break
    }

    total_reads_trim <- total_reads_trim + length(fq_chunk)

    # Mengambil skor kualitas
    qual_matrix <- as(quality(fq_chunk), "matrix")

    # Menghitung rata-rata kualitas
    mean_q <- rowMeans(qual_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
  
    # Filtering menggunakan threshold terpilih
    pass_filter <- !is.na(mean_q) &
      mean_q >= best_threshold

    fq_filtered <- fq_chunk[pass_filter]

    total_pass_filter <- total_pass_filter + sum(pass_filter)

    if (length(fq_filtered) > 0) {

      # Mengambil sequence dan quality
      seq_trim_input <- as.character(sread(fq_filtered))

      qual_trim_input <- qual_matrix[
        pass_filter,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      # Melakukan trimming setiap read
      trimmed <- lapply(
        seq_along(seq_trim_input),
        function(i) {

          trim_one(
            seq_trim_input[i],
            qual_trim_input[i, ],
            W = W,
            Qmin = Qmin
          )

        }
      )

      # Mengambil hasil sequence dan panjang read
      trim_seq <- vapply(
        trimmed,
        function(z) z$seq,
        character(1)
      ) 

      end_pos <- vapply(
        trimmed,
        function(z) z$end,
        integer(1)
      )
 
      # Filter panjang minimum 20 bp
      keep_trim <- end_pos >= min_len

      if (any(keep_trim)) {

        # Mengubah skor Phred kembali ke karakter FASTQ
        trim_qual <- vapply(
          trimmed[keep_trim],
          function(z) {
            intToUtf8(as.integer(z$qual) + 33L)
          },
          character(1)
        )

        # Membuat objek FASTQ hasil trimming
        fq_trimmed <- ShortReadQ(
          sread = DNAStringSet(trim_seq[keep_trim]),
          quality = BStringSet(trim_qual),
          id = id(fq_filtered)[keep_trim]
        )

        # Menyimpan hasil setiap chunk
        writeFastq(
          fq_trimmed,
          clean_fastq_path,
          mode = if (file.exists(clean_fastq_path)) "a" else "w",
          compress = TRUE
        )

        total_pass_trim <- total_pass_trim + sum(keep_trim)

        # Mengumpulkan distribusi Phred akhir
        final_q_values <- as.integer(
          unlist(
            lapply(
              trimmed[keep_trim],
              function(z) z$qual
            ),
            use.names = FALSE
          )
        )

        phred_counts_final <-
          phred_counts_final +
          tabulate(final_q_values + 1L, nbins = 94L)

      }

    }

    cat(
      "Total read:", total_reads_trim,
      "| Lolos filter:", total_pass_filter,
      "| Lolos trimming:", total_pass_trim,
      "\n"
    )

  }

}, finally = {
  close(stream_trim)
})


# J. SUMMARY AKHIR PRE-PROCESSING
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
selected_reads <- hasil_filtering$read_lolos_filter[
  hasil_filtering$threshold == best_threshold
]

hasil_trimming <- data.frame(

  threshold_terpilih = best_threshold,

  total_read_awal = total_reads_trim,

  read_lolos_filter = total_pass_filter,

  read_lolos_trimming = total_pass_trim,

  survival_rate_filter = round(
    total_pass_filter / total_reads_trim * 100,
    2
  ),

  survival_rate_akhir = round(
    total_pass_trim / total_reads_trim * 100,
    2
  ),

  mean_phred_akhir = if (sum(phred_counts_final) > 0) {
    sum(phred_levels * phred_counts_final) /
      sum(phred_counts_final)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("       SUMMARY AKHIR PRE-PROCESSING     \n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(hasil_trimming)


# K. DISTRIBUSI PHRED AKHIR SETELAH TRIMMING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

distribusi_phred_akhir <- data.frame(

  phred_score = phred_levels,

  jumlah_basa = phred_counts_final,

  persentase = if (sum(phred_counts_final) > 0) {
    phred_counts_final / sum(phred_counts_final) * 100
  } else {
    rep(0, length(phred_levels))
  }

)

write.csv(
  distribusi_phred_akhir,
  "results/phred_distribution_final.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# L. MENYIMPAN SELURUH RINGKASAN
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  hasil_trimming,
  "results/trimming_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    hasil_filtering = hasil_filtering,
    hasil_trimming = hasil_trimming,
    distribusi_phred_filtering = distribusi_phred_filtering,
    distribusi_phred_akhir = distribusi_phred_akhir,
    threshold_terpilih = best_threshold
  ),
  "results/summary_listing3.rds"
)


# M. INFORMASI FILE HASIL
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("       PRE-PROCESSING SELESAI           \n")
cat("========================================\n")

if (file.exists(clean_fastq_path)) {

  cat("File clean FASTQ :", clean_fastq_path, "\n")

  cat(
    "Ukuran file      :",
    round(file.info(clean_fastq_path)$size / 1024^2, 2),
    "MB\n"
  )

} else {

  cat("Tidak ada read yang lolos seluruh tahapan.\n")

}

cat("\nSeluruh summary tersimpan di folder results.\n")

```

## Tahap2: Indexing&ReadAlignment(CleanFASTQ→SAM)

```{r}
# mengunduh genom yang paling dominan 
# sumber : https://trace.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Traces/?view=run_browser&acc=SRR8500451&display=analysis
library(rentrez)


ref_acc  <- "NC_017022.1"   # Enterococcus faecium Aus0004, chromosome
ref_url  <- paste0(
  "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?",
  "db=nuccore&id=", ref_acc, "&rettype=fasta&retmode=text"
)
ref_path <- "ref_genome/Enterococcus_NC_017022.1.fasta"

options(timeout = 600)
download.file(ref_url, destfile = ref_path, mode = "wb")

ref_dna <- readDNAStringSet(ref_path)
print(ref_dna)
```

```{r}
clean_fastq_path <- "results/clean_sample.fastq.gz"

ref_fasta <- list.files("ref_genome", pattern = "\\.(fasta|fa)$", full.names = TRUE)[1]

buildindex(basename = "ref_genome/ref_index", reference = ref_fasta, gappedIndex = FALSE)

align(
  index = "ref_genome/ref_index",
  readfile1 = clean_fastq_path,          # results/clean_sample.fastq.gz
  output_file = "results/aligned_reads.sam",
  output_format = "SAM",                 # default Rsubread adalah BAM
  input_format = "gzFASTQ",
  type = "dna",
  nthreads = 2,
  unique = TRUE
)
```

## Tahap3:PemrosesanAlignment(SAM→BAM→SortedBAM+BAI)

```{r}
sam_file          <- "results/aligned_reads.sam"
bam_file          <- "results/aligned_reads.bam"
sorted_bam_prefix <- "results/aligned_reads_sorted"
sorted_bam_file   <- "results/aligned_reads_sorted.bam"

# 1. SAM -> BAM
asBam(file = sam_file, destination = "results/aligned_reads",
      overwrite = TRUE, indexDestination = FALSE)

# 2. Sorting berdasarkan koordinat genom
sortBam(file = bam_file, destination = sorted_bam_prefix)

# 3. Indeks .bai
indexBam(file = sorted_bam_file)

# 4. Statistik pemetaan
idx_stats <- idxstatsBam(sorted_bam_file)
print(idx_stats)

```

```{r}
library(GenomicAlignments)

clean_fastq_path <- "results/clean_sample.fastq.gz"

# 5. Coverage: depth dan breadth
cov <- coverage(sorted_bam_file)
cov_chr <- cov[[1]]                     
mean_depth <- mean(as.numeric(cov_chr))  # rata-rata depth (x)
breadth    <- mean(cov_chr > 0) * 100    # % basa genom yang tertutup read

cat("Mean depth :", round(mean_depth, 3), "x\n")
cat("Breadth    :", round(breadth, 2), "%\n")
cat("Max depth  :", max(cov_chr), "x\n")

```

## Tahap4:VariantCalling&GenerasiFileVCF(SortedBAM→VCF)

```{r}
sorted_bam_file <- "results/aligned_reads_sorted.bam"
ref_fasta       <- "ref_genome/Enterococcus_NC_017022.1.fasta" 
vcf_out_path    <- "results/detected_variants.vcf"

stopifnot(file.exists(sorted_bam_file),
          file.exists(paste0(sorted_bam_file, ".bai")),
          file.exists(ref_fasta))

# Variant calling (SNV)
exactSNP(
  readFile           = sorted_bam_file,
  isBAM              = TRUE,
  refGenomeFile      = ref_fasta,
  outputFile         = vcf_out_path,
  minReads           = 3,      # minimal read pendukung alel alternatif
  minAllelicFraction = 0.2,    # minimal frekuensi alel alternatif
  minBaseQuality     = 20,     # threshold Q20 
  nthreads           = 2
)

# Lanjut hanya jika VCF benar-benar terbentuk
if (!file.exists(vcf_out_path)) stop("VCF tidak terbentuk, cek pesan error exactSNP di atas.")

cat("VCF dibuat:", vcf_out_path, "\n")
cat("Ukuran VCF (MB):", round(file.size(vcf_out_path) / 1024^2, 4), "\n")

# Validasi dan ringkasan dengan VariantAnnotation
vcf <- tryCatch(readVcf(vcf_out_path), error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(vcf)) {
  print(vcf)
  cat("Total varian:", nrow(vcf), "\n")
  print(table(isSNV(vcf)))
} else {
  raw <- read.table(vcf_out_path, comment.char = "#", sep = "\t",
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "")
  cat("Total varian (dibaca manual):", nrow(raw), "\n")
  print(head(raw))
}
```

```{r}
clean_fastq_path <- "results/clean_sample.fastq.gz"
sam_file        <- "results/aligned_reads.sam"
bam_file        <- "results/aligned_reads.bam"
sorted_bam_file <- "results/aligned_reads_sorted.bam"
vcf_out_path    <- "results/detected_variants.vcf"

# 6. Ukuran file untuk tabel log
files <- c(
  clean_fastq = clean_fastq_path,
  sam         = sam_file,
  bam         = bam_file,
  sorted_bam  = sorted_bam_file,
  bai         = paste0(sorted_bam_file, ".bai"),
  vcf         = vcf_out_path
)
sizes <- data.frame(
  file    = names(files),
  size_MB = round(file.size(files) / 1024^2, 3)
)
print(sizes)
```

## audit

```{r}
# AUDIT PIPELINE
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Rsubread); library(Rsamtools); library(GenomicAlignments)
  library(Biostrings); library(ShortRead); library(ggplot2)
})

raw_fastq   <- "raw_data/SRR8500451_1.fastq.gz"
clean_fastq <- "results/clean_sample.fastq.gz"
sam_file    <- "results/aligned_reads.sam"
bam_file    <- "results/aligned_reads.bam"
sorted_bam  <- "results/aligned_reads_sorted.bam"
bai_file    <- paste0(sorted_bam, ".bai")
vcf_file    <- "results/detected_variants.vcf"
ref_fasta   <- "ref_genome/Enterococcus_NC_017022.1.fasta"

mb <- function(f) round(file.size(f) / 1024^2, 3)
dir.create("reports", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------- 0. Cek semua file ada ----------
semua <- c(raw_fastq, clean_fastq, sam_file, bam_file, sorted_bam, bai_file, vcf_file, ref_fasta)
print(data.frame(file = semua, ada = file.exists(semua), ukuran_MB = mb(semua)))

# ---------- 1. Pre-processing (dari CSV yang sudah tersimpan) ----------
filt        <- read.csv("results/filtering_summary.csv")
trim        <- read.csv("results/trimming_summary.csv")
phred_filt  <- read.csv("results/phred_distribution_filtering.csv")
phred_final <- read.csv("results/phred_distribution_final.csv")

cat("\n=== Multi-threshold filtering (Q15/Q20/Q25) ===\n"); print(filt)
cat("\n=== Hasil trimming (threshold terpilih) ===\n");     print(trim)

total_reads  <- trim$total_read_awal
reads_lolos  <- trim$read_lolos_trimming
surv_akhir   <- trim$survival_rate_akhir

# Panjang read sebelum vs sesudah trimming (sampel 20.000 read, cepat)
set.seed(1)
len_raw   <- width(yield(FastqSampler(raw_fastq,   n = 20000)))
len_clean <- width(yield(FastqSampler(clean_fastq, n = 20000)))
cat("\nPanjang read rata-rata: mentah =", round(mean(len_raw), 1),
    "bp | setelah trimming =", round(mean(len_clean), 1), "bp\n")

# ---------- 2. Alignment / mapping rate ----------
idx <- idxstatsBam(sorted_bam)
cat("\n=== idxstats ===\n"); print(idx)
mapped_reads   <- sum(idx$mapped)
unmapped_reads <- sum(idx$unmapped)
mapping_rate   <- mapped_reads / (mapped_reads + unmapped_reads) * 100
cat("Mapped:", mapped_reads, "| Unmapped:", unmapped_reads,
    "| Mapping rate:", round(mapping_rate, 2), "%\n")

cat("\n=== propmapped (Rsubread, dari SAM) ===\n")
print(tryCatch(propmapped(sam_file), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)))

# ---------- 3. Coverage ----------
cov_chr    <- coverage(sorted_bam)[[1]]
depth_vec  <- as.numeric(cov_chr)
mean_depth <- mean(depth_vec)
breadth    <- mean(depth_vec > 0) * 100
depth_cov  <- mean(depth_vec[depth_vec > 0])   # rata-rata hanya di basa yang tertutup
ref_len    <- sum(width(readDNAStringSet(ref_fasta)))

cat("\n=== Coverage ===\n")
cat("Panjang referensi :", ref_len, "bp\n")
cat("Mean depth        :", round(mean_depth, 3), "x\n")
cat("Depth (basa tertutup saja):", round(depth_cov, 3), "x\n")
cat("Breadth coverage  :", round(breadth, 2), "%\n")
cat("Median / Max depth:", median(depth_vec), "/", max(depth_vec), "x\n")
cat("Basa dengan depth >= 5x:", round(mean(depth_vec >= 5) * 100, 2), "%\n")

# ---------- 4. Variant calling (VCF) ----------
vcf_raw <- tryCatch(
  read.table(vcf_file, comment.char = "#", sep = "\t", quote = "",
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE),
  error = function(e) data.frame())

if (nrow(vcf_raw) > 0) {
  names(vcf_raw)[1:5] <- c("CHROM", "POS", "ID", "REF", "ALT")
  is_snv   <- nchar(vcf_raw$REF) == 1 & nchar(vcf_raw$ALT) == 1
  n_snv    <- sum(is_snv)
  n_indel  <- sum(!is_snv)
  pair     <- paste0(vcf_raw$REF[is_snv], vcf_raw$ALT[is_snv])
  ts       <- sum(pair %in% c("AG", "GA", "CT", "TC"))
  tv       <- n_snv - ts
  cat("\n=== VCF ===\n")
  cat("Total varian:", nrow(vcf_raw), "| SNV:", n_snv, "| InDel:", n_indel, "\n")
  cat("Kepadatan   :", round(n_snv / (ref_len / 1e6), 1), "SNV per Mb\n")
  cat("Ts/Tv ratio :", round(ts / max(tv, 1), 2), " (Ts =", ts, ", Tv =", tv, ")\n")
  cat("Contoh kolom INFO:\n"); print(head(vcf_raw[, ncol(vcf_raw)], 3))
} else {
  n_snv <- 0; n_indel <- 0
  cat("\nVCF kosong / tidak terbaca.\n")
}

# ---------- 5. TABEL LOG EVALUASI (siap salin ke laporan) ----------
tabel_log <- data.frame(
  Tahap = c("0. Data Mentah", "1. Pre-processing", "2. Read Alignment",
            "3. Compression & Sorting", "4. Indexing", "5. Variant Calling"),
  Input  = c("-", "FASTQ", "Clean FASTQ", "SAM", "Sorted BAM", "Sorted BAM"),
  Output = c("FASTQ", "Clean FASTQ", "SAM", "Sorted BAM", "BAI", "VCF"),
  Ukuran_MB = c(mb(raw_fastq), mb(clean_fastq), mb(sam_file), mb(sorted_bam), mb(bai_file), mb(vcf_file)),
  Metrik = c(
    paste0("Total Read: ", format(total_reads, big.mark = ".")),
    paste0("Read Lolos: ", format(reads_lolos, big.mark = "."), " (", surv_akhir, "%)"),
    paste0("Mapped Reads: ", format(mapped_reads, big.mark = "."), " (", round(mapping_rate, 2), "%)"),
    paste0("Coverage Depth: ", round(mean_depth, 3), "x (breadth ", round(breadth, 2), "%)"),
    "Indeks Genomic Coordinate",
    paste0("Total SNV/Indel: ", n_snv + n_indel, " (SNV ", n_snv, ", InDel ", n_indel, ")")
  )
)
cat("\n=== TABEL LOG EVALUASI ===\n"); print(tabel_log, right = FALSE)
write.csv(tabel_log, "results/tabel_log_evaluasi.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---------- 6. Grafik untuk presentasi (tersimpan di reports/) ----------
p1 <- ggplot(filt, aes(factor(paste0("Q", threshold)), survival_rate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") + geom_text(aes(label = paste0(survival_rate, "%")), vjust = -0.3) +
  labs(x = "Ambang kualitas", y = "Read survival (%)", title = "Survival rate per ambang kualitas") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("reports/grafik_survival_rate.png", p1, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 200)

phred_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(phred = phred_filt$phred_score, persen = phred_filt$Q15, set = "Filter Q15"),
  data.frame(phred = phred_filt$phred_score, persen = phred_filt$Q20, set = "Filter Q20"),
  data.frame(phred = phred_filt$phred_score, persen = phred_filt$Q25, set = "Filter Q25"),
  data.frame(phred = phred_final$phred_score, persen = phred_final$persentase, set = "Akhir (filter+trimming)"))
p2 <- ggplot(phred_long[phred_long$phred <= 45, ], aes(phred, persen, colour = set)) +
  geom_line() + labs(x = "Skor Phred", y = "% basa", title = "Distribusi Phred") + theme_minimal()
ggsave("reports/grafik_distribusi_phred.png", p2, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 200)

p3 <- ggplot(data.frame(depth = pmin(depth_vec, quantile(depth_vec, 0.99))), aes(depth)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(x = "Depth (x), dipotong di persentil 99", y = "Jumlah basa", title = "Distribusi coverage depth") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("reports/grafik_coverage_depth.png", p3, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 200)

if (nrow(vcf_raw) > 0) {
  p4 <- ggplot(vcf_raw, aes(POS)) + geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "firebrick") +
    labs(x = "Posisi di kromosom (bp)", y = "Jumlah varian", title = "Sebaran varian di genom") +
    theme_minimal()
  ggsave("reports/grafik_sebaran_varian.png", p4, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 200)
}
cat("\nGrafik tersimpan di folder reports/\n")
```

## uji variat calling (q15,q20,q25)

```{r}
thr <- c(15, 20, 25)
hasil_q <- data.frame(Q = thr, SNV = NA_integer_)
for (i in seq_along(thr)) {
  out <- paste0("results/detected_variants_Q", thr[i], ".vcf")
  exactSNP(readFile = sorted_bam, isBAM = TRUE, refGenomeFile = ref_fasta,
           outputFile = out, minReads = 3, minAllelicFraction = 0.2,
           minBaseQuality = thr[i], nthreads = 2)
  hasil_q$SNV[i] <- nrow(read.table(out, comment.char = "#", sep = "\t", quote = "", fill = TRUE))
}
print(hasil_q)
```
